item.title: About me
item.description:
I am a versatile computer science professional with a strong foundation in programming, computer security, and artificial intelligence. My education has equipped me with a diverse set of skills, making me adept at tackling complex technical challenges.

Key Skills

  • 💻 Programming and Development: Proficient in multiple programming languages, algorithms, data structures, web development, and software engineering.
  • 🔒 Computer Security: Knowledgeable in cryptography, network security, information security practices, and legal aspects of computer crimes.
  • 🤖 Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning: Skilled in AI techniques, neural networks, and machine learning algorithms.
  • 📐 Mathematics and Logic: Strong analytical skills with a solid foundation in linear algebra, discrete mathematics, statistics, and algorithmic analysis.
  • 🖥️ Computer Theory and Systems: Familiar with computer architecture, operating systems, networking, and theoretical computer science.
  • 🖱️ Human-Computer Interaction: Understanding of user interface design principles.
  • 📈 Business and Marketing: Basics of digital marketing strategies.
  • 🌐 Language: Proficient in English.

Experience

Through multiple team projects and a bachelor thesis, I have developed strong collaboration and research skills, applying theoretical knowledge to practical scenarios.
